reference: White Cat Kit Card, Mike Kasberg, Printables 865769, CC BY 4.0

mappedParameters.sheet: Measured 1.6 mm default, adjustable 1.6–2.4 mm; all actual crossing plates use this thickness
mappedParameters.fit: Source slot width minus sheet is ~.100012 mm. Proposed .15 mm TOTAL allowance (.1–.3), applied to both directions of all nine real cross-laps; not physically calibrated
mappedParameters.thickness: Original redesigned lap datum 9–12 mm above bed, not source 4.5 mm slot length
mappedParameters.tabHeight: Original .4–.6 mm runners; source .21/.22 mm low planes recorded but not copied as universally printable
mappedParameters.shape: Three end-clipping silhouettes; the top ruling stays straight except cosmetic end clips

designDecisions: Six original plates replace source spacecraft parts; three bottom-open X ribs cross three top-open Y rails
Nine complementary half-laps seated at one datum leave a direct vertical insertion/removal path
Top edges sample z=H+4R*x*y/(X*Y); three rulings in each direction reveal a sparse saddle, not a closed surface
Y rails extend 4 mm past outer X-rib centrelines so the slots remain enclosed at their ends
Engraving restricted to signature X rib, above slots, centered at Xspan/6 and .68*centreHeight; .4–.6 mm cut preserves at least 1 mm backing
A two-column, three-row reconstructed carrier uses 24 accessible bed-level runners placed below slot datums
No positive lift retention: deliberate loose cross-laps; optional adhesive at nine seats for permanent display
No raw source asset redistributed; source defects not copied or claimed repaired
